sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy dominates as the sole all-green sector, while Technology and Financials edge higher at the expense of fading Materials and Healthcare.

Energy continues to lead the US equity market, holding the number one rank with a momentum score of 0.87 and acting as the only sector with positive performance across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD). Behind it, Technology (+1 spot to rank 2, momentum 0.78) and Financials (+1 spot to rank 7, momentum 0.68) are showing positive near-term rotation, alongside Industrials (+1 spot to rank 4, momentum 0.48).

Conversely, defensive and cyclical sectors are losing ground. Basic Materials (rank 3) and Healthcare (rank 5) both slipped 1 spot over the last 5 sessions despite maintaining relatively high momentum scores. Meanwhile, Utilities (momentum 0.15) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.27) remain deeply entrenched as momentum laggards near the bottom of the YTD rankings.

## Strength
* **Energy Dominance:** Energy is the only sector out of 11 to achieve "all-green" status, showing positive performance across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD with a top-ranked momentum score of 0.87.
* **Tech and Financials Advancing:** Technology gained 1 spot to reach rank 2 with a strong momentum score of 0.78, while Financials also improved by 1 spot to rank 7 with a momentum score of 0.68.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Financials (rank 7), Industrials (rank 4, momentum 0.48), and Technology (rank 2) each improved their rankings by +1 spot over the last 5 sessions.
* **Top Losers:** Basic Materials (rank 3, momentum 0.67), Healthcare (rank 5, momentum 0.65), and Consumer Defensive (rank 8, momentum 0.27) all fell by -1 spot over the same 5-session period.
* **Deep Laggards:** Utilities (momentum 0.15, rank 9) and Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.32, rank 11) remain anchored at the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum Leaders:** Basic Materials (momentum 0.67) and Healthcare (momentum 0.65) are showing early signs of weakness, with both sectors slipping -1 rank spot over the last 5 sessions despite their high overall momentum scores.
* **Lagging Financials:** Despite a 5-day rank improvement of +1, Financials sit at rank 7 with a momentum score of 0.68, lagging behind its high-momentum peers like Technology and Energy in YTD performance.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy, staffing, and health tech dominate the market's highly concentrated leadership (only 15 of 144 groups are all-green), while consumer cyclicals and retail suffer sharp weekly declines.

Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing leads the market with an exceptional momentum score of 0.97, closely supported by Staffing & Employment Services (0.88) and Health Information Services (0.87). Coal is experiencing a powerful rotation, with Coking Coal jumping 23 spots to rank 40 and Thermal Coal rising 22 spots to rank 64. Software - Infrastructure also saw a massive weekly jump of 24 spots to rank 60.

On the downside, retail and manufacturing are fading rapidly. Textile Manufacturing dropped 28 spots to rank 61, Specialty Retail lost 25 spots to rank 100, and Travel Services fell 20 spots to rank 113. Meanwhile, consumer-facing laggards like Footwear & Accessories (0.04 momentum) and Airports & Air Services (0.11 momentum) remain anchored at the bottom of the YTD rankings.

## Strength
* **Extremely Narrow Breadth:** Only 15 out of 144 groups maintain all-green status (positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD), highlighting a highly concentrated market.
* **Dominant Leaders:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.97) and Staffing & Employment Services (momentum 0.88) anchor the all-green cohort.
* **Sustained Performance:** Health Information Services, Marine Shipping, Biotechnology, and Diagnostics & Research continue to show sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Rapid Gainers:** Software - Infrastructure surged 24 spots to rank 60 (momentum 0.75), while Coking Coal gained 23 spots to rank 40 (momentum 0.86).
* **Sharp Declines:** Textile Manufacturing plummeted 28 spots (rank 61, momentum 0.21) and Specialty Retail dropped 25 spots (rank 100, momentum 0.22).
* **Deep Laggards:** Footwear & Accessories (momentum 0.04, YTD rank 141) and Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.11, YTD rank 140) show no signs of recovery.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Gold (momentum 0.61, rank -9 in 5d) and Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.66, rank -5 in 5d) are slipping in rank despite historically strong momentum.
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Education & Training Services (rank +15, momentum 0.46) and Aerospace & Defense (rank +12, momentum 0.45) are jumping in rank despite currently low momentum scores.
